text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Cheered on by a large crowd full of<n>hopeful
spectators, Taiki Shuttle is<n>determined not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Beating Silence Suzuka will continue<n>her winning
streak in the G1 sprints,<n>giving her an additional
push toward<n>becoming Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thus, Taiki Shuttle keeps blazing<n>forward in order to
achieve her<n>dream!
